pitch: Tangle gives people and agents one visible ML canvas: WebMCP tools build and undo pipelines, then train classifiers, clusters and Product2Vec locally without exposing data.

about.inspiration: Visual ML tools make pipelines understandable, but coordinate-based agents have to guess at nodes, ports, and state. Tangle already had a real graph, validation, and undo, so the project makes that same workspace structured and safely actionable through WebMCP.
about.what_it_does: People and agents assemble, validate, run, and interpret curated classification, clustering, and embedding pipelines in the browser. Four recipes and human-readable reports use deterministic synthetic equipment and commerce data.
about.why_webmcp: The page exposes stable names, JSON schemas, task IDs, port names, typed results, and explicit errors instead of relying on visual scraping. This makes multi-step graph edits and analysis more reliable while preserving a narrow capability boundary.
about.better_user_experience: Agent changes appear on the same visible canvas, use normal undo, and are reported in a status panel. A person must grant one-time execution permission and can explore the same result report.
about.people_and_agents_together: The agent can inspect, search, build, configure, connect, validate, request execution, and interpret; the person reviews, edits, authorizes, explores, and undoes.
about.how_built: A thin TypeScript adapter reuses Tangle's React/MobX/React Flow state and undo APIs. Deterministic models execute in an ES-module Web Worker; React components render classifier, cluster, and embedding reports. OpenAI Sites hosts the demo.
about.webmcp_implementation: The editor calls document.modelContext.registerTool for ten bounded tools. Curated component IDs, runtime validation, separate browser compatibility checks, one-run permission, safe errors, and concise summary tools define the boundary.
about.challenges: Selecting a safe public surface, separating editor validity from browser capability, keeping results useful without returning rows, producing readable agent graph layouts, preserving deep links, and validating declared schemas at runtime.
about.accomplishments: Ten real deployed tools; visible undoable changes; working one-run permission; live churn, four-cluster, and Product2Vec runs; deterministic documented data; and 2,260 runnable tests passing.
about.learnings: Intention-level tools are more trustworthy than mirroring every UI command; agents should share real app state and undo; JSON Schema needs runtime enforcement; browser-local ML needs both agent-readable and human-explorable outputs.
about.next: Push the reviewed release, restore and enable judge access, deploy strict no-input validation, return a concise run result, add visible cancellation and saved comparisons, and test more clients.
about.submission_period_changes: From upstream d7768e85, ten commits dated 3 September 2026 added the WebMCP adapter/tools, Worker runner, bounded models including Product2Vec, synthetic datasets, four recipes, commerce landing page, reports, readable layout, permission UI, Sites routing, tests, and documentation.
